question.text: The AIR template question 'How is the organization attending to the challenge or planning to attend to the challenge?' falls under which section of the AIR?

explanation.text: The Logic: Under the SEBI AIR framework, 'Strategic Intent and Planning' captures: what challenge the SE is addressing, how the SE is attending or planning to attend to the challenge, the target segment, and the expected outcomes (including unintended negatives). The 'how' question in the stem is exactly this template item. The Trap: Approach deals with baseline and implementation; Impact Score Card deals with metrics; Utilisation Statement is a separate 91F document. Each is a close-sounding but wrong bucket. Cross-Exam Context: PDF chapter sample Q3 - direct recall. SIAB quality-review checklists use this mapping when scoring AIR drafts. Assessor's Pro-Tip: When walking through the AIR draft with the SE's program head, use the SEBI template questions verbatim as conversation prompts. Programme heads answer more clearly when asked 'How are you attending?' than when asked 'Describe your Strategic Intent'.
